description: This Java class defines a custom database change set for use with Liquibase, aimed at validating and warning about specific configurations within the OpenMRS healthcare platform, particularly related to patient programs and workflow states.

classes.name: ProgramValidatorChangeSet
classes.description: A class implementing a custom Liquibase task for validating patient program configurations in OpenMRS, including checks for states marked as both initial and terminal, and workflows with no initial states.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the validation by executing SQL queries to identify misconfigured program states and workflows, then reports warnings.

methods.name: getConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating completion of validation.

methods.name: setFileOpener
methods.description: Setter method for ResourceAccessor, no implementation needed.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initialization method for the custom change, no specific setup performed.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the change, returning empty validation errors indicating no specific validation logic.
